name: Methanol
description: Methanol. Added to a swab to make a dried bloodstain more adhesive so it transfers onto the swab.

name: Phenolphthalein
description: Phenolphthalein reagent. Part of the Kastle-Meyer presumptive test for blood.

name: Hydrogen Peroxide
description: Hydrogen peroxide. The final reagent in the Kastle-Meyer test. A positive result turns the swab pink.

name: Swab Pack
description: A sterile, pre-moistened swab used to collect the dried bloodstain for packaging.

name: Plastic Vial
description: A plastic vial / capsule the collection swab is placed into before bagging.

name: Paper Evidence Bag
description: A paper evidence bag. Labelled with initials, time, location, case number and exhibit number.

name: Tamper Evident Tape
description: Tamper-evident tape used to seal the evidence bag so any tampering is visible.

name: Magnetic Powder
description: White/grey magnetic powder used to dust the knife handlebar for latent fingerprints. The powder reveals fingerprint ridges without affecting them.

name: Fingerprint Scale
description: A reference scale placed next to the fingerprint during photography to show relative size and provide a size reference.

name: Fingerprint Tape
description: Clear lifting tape / gel lifter used to carefully lift the dusted fingerprint without damaging it.

name: Backing Card
description: A backing card used to mount and preserve the lifted fingerprint. Must be labelled with case information, initials, and directionality marker.
